headline: Pistis Model Family Unveiled: 27B- and 9B-Parameter Multimodal LLMs
summary: The Pistis model family, consisting of 27B- and 9B-parameter multimodal large language models, has been introduced, marking a significant advancement in the scale and capability of multimodal LLMs. This development is driving innovation in various sectors, including finance, DNA sequencing, and more.
whyItMatters: The introduction of these models is expanding the scope of applications for multimodal LLMs and setting new benchmarks for performance and scale in the AI industry.
